lines.zh: 我一摆尾，往温热的石头挪。
lines.en: I flick my tail toward the warm stones.

lines.zh: 蝌蚪的身子拖着一缕灰。
lines.en: My tadpole body drags a wisp of ash.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，尾巴打圈。
lines.en: I skim the surface, tail circling.

lines.zh: 灰烬在我身后落成一条线。
lines.en: Ash falls in a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我往热源那边一点点挪。
lines.en: I inch toward the heat.
My tail touches the stone first.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰浮起来。
lines.en: Where I pass, ash lifts.
I swim slowly; my body is still growing.
I squeeze between the water weeds.

lines.zh: 一行浅浅的尾痕留在泥上。
lines.en: A shallow tail trail stays in the mud.
I rise and fall with the ripples.
I head for the darker water.

lines.zh: 我漂着，身上还冒一点烟。
lines.en: I float, still giving off a little smoke.
My tail sways and the ripples spread.

lines.zh: 我鼓了鼓腮，吐出一口气。
lines.en: I puff my cheeks and let out a breath.
Ash falls into the water and vanishes.
I press against a warm stone on the bank.
The water cools; I shrink deeper.
I wait to grow another ring.

lines.zh: 这具身子太软，站不起来。
lines.en: This body is too soft to stand.

lines.zh: 我对着水面看自己的影子。
lines.en: I look at my own reflection.

lines.zh: 灰烬在水底积成薄薄一层。
lines.en: Ash settles in a thin layer below.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，尾巴却在动。
lines.en: I am still, but my tail is not.

lines.zh: 我记得自己不是从卵里出来的。
lines.en: I remember I did not come from an egg.
A weed brushes my back.

lines.zh: 我在听岸上有没有脚步声。
lines.en: I listen for steps on the bank.
You carry something warm.
You crouch, and the ripples break.
I lift my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了半片水。
lines.en: Your shadow covers half the pool.
No net; I dislike nets.

lines.zh: 我认得你的手，喂过我的。
lines.en: I know your hands; they have fed me.
The water trembles when you speak.
I swim a little closer, then stop.
Your palm is warm.
Could your palm hold me?
I tilt my head; I do not understand.

lines.zh: 你身上还有别的伙伴的气味。
lines.en: You smell of other companions.

lines.zh: 我吐出一小串泡，算回应。
lines.en: I release a small string of bubbles in reply.

lines.zh: 我靠到你手边，蹭了一下。
lines.en: I drift to your hand and nudge it.
Your boots are wet; sorry.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我只是条蝌蚪。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I am only a tadpole.
The water is cool; put your hand in.

lines.zh: 我会跟着你的，只要你不走快。
lines.en: I will follow, if you do not walk fast.
I flinch and the water splashes.
It hurts; my body is too soft.
A patch of ash falls off me.

lines.zh: 我沉到水底，又慢慢浮起。
lines.en: I sink to the bottom and slowly rise.
My tail curls into a ball.
This soft body of mine cannot take a blow.
I hide in the weeds.
My skin is thin; I cannot take much.

lines.zh: 我发出一点细细的声音。
lines.en: I make a small, thin sound.
Stop; I do not last long.
I smell that ember.
Give me a little heat, just a little.
I flick my tail that way.
Ash and sweetness mix oddly.
I open my mouth and wait for it to fall.
The warmth of the embers draws me in.
Warm things are good food.
I curl my tail around it.

lines.zh: 别一下全给我，我吃不完。
lines.en: Not all at once; I cannot finish it.
Good; I have your scent now.
You stepped on me; easy.
I bump your boot and bounce off.

lines.zh: 这一碰，水花溅了你一脸。
lines.en: The splash catches you in the face.
I am too soft to hurt you.
I slide away from your feet.

lines.zh: 别站在浅水里，我看不清。
lines.en: Don't stand in the shallows; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，水就浑了。
lines.en: We touch and the water clouds.
Your leg is warmer than the stones.
I back off a foot into the weeds.
Now I must straighten my tail.
I am only a tadpole.
Ask me once I have legs.

lines.zh: 这池水里没有第二个我。
lines.en: There is no second me in this pool.
I do not understand this; stop asking.
I flick my tail and swim off.
My body is not finished; I cannot speak of it.

lines.zh: 水里的伙伴不这样成对。
lines.en: Companions in the water do not pair like that.
I must grow first.
I sink to the bottom and pretend not to hear.
I have not even grown legs yet.
I curl my tail around it.

lines.zh: 它沉下来，正好落在我嘴边。
lines.en: It sinks and lands right at my mouth.
Too small; it slips through.
I press it into the mud with my tail.
I hold it in my mouth; it feels cool.
It tastes too much of ash; I spit it out.
I cup it with my two small front feet.
I cannot drag it, so I push.
There, tucked by my cheek.
Dropped it; let me look again.
The water moves; I turn that way.

lines.zh: 有东西在岸上，我看着它。
lines.en: Something is on the bank; I watch it.
My ash drifts a little that way.
I am not fierce, but I will follow.
My companion is calling; I hear it.
That shadow does not look friendly.
I puff up, ready to swim.
I am at your feet; don't be afraid.
I can feel the hostility.
I drift slowly toward it.
I have noted that sound.
Step back; let me look first.
I am watching this direction.
My tail tip points that way.
It is closing; I am counting.
Its trembling reaches me through the water.
I follow along the bottom.
Its shadow sways on the surface.
I swim along the shade of the water weeds.
One tail flick moves me a foot.
I follow the ripples after it.

lines.zh: 我浮到它够不着的高度。
lines.en: I float up where it cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我停一下，听它还在不在。
lines.en: I pause to hear if it is still there.
My ash falls at its feet.
Don't look back; I am right behind.
It speeds up; I cannot keep pace.
I try to make no sound.
The water's warmth changed; it is nearby.
I cling to the bank and wait.
I know the muddy path along the bottom.
I hug the mud and move only my tail.
I swim inside its shadow.
I am in the shadow beneath it.
I circle slowly, without startling it.
I headbutt it with my wet, soft head.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，没什么力气。
lines.en: My tail lashes out, without much force.
I clamp onto its trouser leg.
I lunge, then slide off.
That was just enough to distract it.

lines.zh: 我把身上的灰甩到它脸上。
lines.en: I fling my ash into its face.
It kicks me into the water.
I bite; my teeth are small.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我趁机游开。
lines.en: It steps back and I swim clear.
I am still hot; it pulls its hand back.
I lunge again and miss.
Panting, my tail still swings.
It stomps; I slip aside.
Good; now it knows I am not easy.
I put myself in front of you.
One more and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我从模组的机制里被唤出。
lines.en: I am called forth by the mod's own means.
A string of bubbles rises first.
I drop into the shallows with a small splash.
I still carry the ash of my making.

lines.zh: 这池水是凉的，我打个颤。
lines.en: This pool is cold; I shiver.

lines.zh: 我抬头看岸，全是陌生的。
lines.en: I look at the bank; all of it is strange.
I flick my tail to test the water.
Is there anywhere warm nearby?
My body is pitifully small.

lines.zh: 我得先找个能躲的地方。
lines.en: First I need somewhere to hide.
Shadows are moving on the bank.
I sink until only my eyes show.
A trace of warmth in the water; just right.
I do not know this world yet.

lines.zh: 有人在看我，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Someone is watching me; I can feel it.
This pool is shallow enough to hide me.
Don't grab me yet.
I was born with a bit of fire in me.
The heat drives me down into the water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下来，砸在石上。
lines.en: I fall from the bank onto stone.

lines.zh: 水里我也喘不上气，奇怪。
lines.en: Even in water I cannot breathe; strange.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从水里掀了出来。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the water.
The arrowhead tears through my tail fin.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着水缠上我。
lines.en: That force coils through the water to me.

lines.zh: 没有热的东西，我越来越冷。
lines.en: No warmth, and I grow colder.
The lightning chases my tail through the water.
The water is gone; my tail flails.
